description: This file defines a Java interface 'PolicyQueryCommandResponse' that extends two other interfaces, 'PolicyCommandResponse' and 'WithEntity'. It provides method signatures for setting entity data and Ditto headers, intended for querying the state of policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: PolicyQueryCommandResponse
classes.description: A parameterized Java interface for responses to policy query commands, allowing chaining of method calls to set entity data and headers.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity data as a JsonValue, returning the response object for chaining.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers, returning the response object for chaining.
